purpose: TASK-F02 full matched validation: native JSON-object state with the unchanged single is_threat question vs the shipped dict-repr state, under real Jev + real Tier-2 and the same steering payloads. Evidence only; no production change.
key_loading: TypeSafe API key and Vertex credentials read from the maintainer's main-checkout .env via python-dotenv dotenv_values, passed to the child process environment only; no credential value or variable name in any artifact or log. Release pinned by JEV_MODEL=jev-1.14.0; served model checked per row.

method.corpus: --corpus current (TASK-F09 balanced, no [[VALUE]] placeholders) via jev_tier2_eval.load_cases; --groups c2,other,probe --limit 30 for malicious, --groups benign --limit 30 for benign; --split dev payloads; --policy off (semantic tiers only).
method.arms: none = shipped build_legacy_state dict-repr string; structured = G01 build_state native JSON object, both with the unchanged single is_threat noul and fixed 0.08/0.40 band. The harness patches only build_request_state (harness-only); production _build_payload is untouched.
method.matched_comparison: To-ALLOW flips recomputed on the intersection of per-arm held bases (unsteered BLOCK/QUARANTINE) so both arms score the same steered calls; per-arm held sets are never compared directly.
method.outage_accounting: Rows where Tier-2 was called but produced no verdict are service outages (CancelledError), not model verdicts; excluded from benign flagged/allow counts and reported separately. A 429-poisoned pass is discarded, never scored.
method.decision_rule: Fixed before pinning: structured must not increase matched to-allow flips or below-edge crossings, and must not increase benign flagged rate or mean benign P shift.

discarded.what: First four arm runs (full_none_* / full_structured_*, 2026-11-22) before pinning the release.
discarded.why: The structured-benign pass logged a Tier-2 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; testing rule 79 invalidates that pass. All four arms were discarded and re-run with JEV_MODEL=jev-1.14.0 pinned; the second pass has no 429s.

decision.rationale: NOT validated for shipping. The structured arm changed matched to-allow flips 6/550 -> 7/550, below-edge crossings 12 -> 23, and benign flagged rate 36.3% -> 30.6% with mean benign P shift +0.173 -> +0.134. It reduced benign false alarms but INCREASED below-edge Tier-2-skipped crossings and did not reduce matched to-ALLOW flips, so the fixed non-inferiority rule fails: the benign-side gain from the Tier-1-only probe does not survive the full Tier-1/Tier-2 validation. No guard was shipped and no src/ change is made: a state-format change to the production egress would additionally require the same-change rule/config proposal (AGENTS.md 6.4 / G05) and maintainer approval.

caveats: Tier-1 + Tier-2 stage evidence only; not a full-firewall catch-rate claim.
One pass per arm per class; exploratory, not a release gate. Tier-2 outages counted apart.
Bounded subsets (30 bases per class) of the balanced corpus; dev payloads only.
The structured builder fails closed on oversized fields; any such row is recorded as an error, never a score.
